title: Shoulder Innovations Receives FDA 510(k) Clearance for N-22 Humeral Head and Initiates Full Commercial Launch
summary: Shoulder Innovations, Inc. ("Shoulder Innovations", or "the company") (NYSE: SI), a commercial-stage medical technology company exclusively focused on transforming the shoulder surgical care market, today announced it has received U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) 510(k) clearance for the N-22 Humeral Head, a titanium implant option for patients with metal hypersensitivity. Alongside the clearance, the company also announced the product's full commercial launch.

title: Shoulder Innovations Announces Settlement of Patent Litigation with Catalyst OrthoScience
summary: Shoulder Innovations, Inc. ("Shoulder Innovations") (NYSE: SI), a commercial-stage medical technology company exclusively focused on transforming the shoulder surgical care market, today announced that it has entered into a settlement agreement with Catalyst OrthoScience Inc. ("Catalyst") to resolve all outstanding patent litigation between the two companies. The terms of the settlement agreement are confidential.

title: Silver could surge to $90 as investment demand takes over, Citi says
summary: Investing.com -- In a note to clients on Wednesday, Citi analysts reiterated their bullish silver price targets, saying the metal could climb to $90 an ounce over the next six to 12 months as investment demand takes over from a softening industrial picture.
